name: Shokushu Makai no Ryoshuu ~Himekishi Ixia Kanraku.........
original_name: 触手魔界の虜囚～姫騎士イクシア陥落………
source:
The Kingdom of Lanrod was a small country with rich resources.
It was established a long time ago to seal off the evil god with the courtesy of the goddess Elixia and to maintain it.
However, now that it became a legend, and a lustful wizard destroyed the royal seal with vicious intention, which resulted in the collapse of the kingdom itself.
Luckily, the evil god has yet to revive. The remaining seal of the goddess are shattered and kept in some brave men's body of the destroyed kingdom.
Ixia was among them, and Zodiac plans to assault and weaken her to get one of the key to take off the seal completely...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ089208.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
蘭羅德王國雖小，卻資源富饒。很久以前，在女神艾莉克希婭的庇佑下，人們為封印邪神而建立此國，並世代維繫封印。然而，傳說逐漸被人遺忘，一名心懷惡意的淫邪魔法師破壞了王家的封印，王國也隨之覆滅。

所幸邪神尚未復活。女神殘存的封印已經碎裂，其碎片寄宿在亡國幾名勇者的體內。姬騎士伊克希婭正是其中之一。為了奪取徹底解除封印所需的一把鑰匙，佐迪亞克打算凌辱她、削弱她的力量……
